description: This Java class 'HelloController' provides basic REST endpoints for a Spring Boot application, including welcome, documentation redirect, health check, and info endpoints.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: Controller class with endpoints for health check, documentation, and info in the insurance management backend.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message indicating the application has started successfully.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to the Swagger UI documentation page.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Provides a health status response for monitoring purposes.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns application information about the insurancemanagementbackend.
